subject: Orchard AI discovery — recap, success criteria, and proposed MAP
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orchardai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Orchard AI discovery — recap, success criteria, and proposed MAP

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for taking time today — great to learn more about Orchard AI and the latency/cost challenges you're seeing in production. Below is a short recap of what we heard on the call, the suggested success criteria, and a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached). Please confirm anything I got wrong or missing stakeholders.

Call highlights / pain points
- Spiky inference latency at peak traffic (3x above SLO) impacting user experience.
- High token cost on current managed service (mainly for long-context batch workloads).
- Need for predictable throughput for synchronous inference and also a cost-effective async batch path.
- Regulatory/compliance constraints: internal audit wants an evidence trail (SOC 2) and control over retention windows.
- Interest in model variants: want to evaluate quantized variants and a slightly fine-tuned base model for improved relevance.

Goals / success criteria
- Pilot demonstrates median latency < 120ms at representative QPS and a 30% reduction in per-token cost vs today.
- Clear path to production-ready Dedicated or Private deployment by end of July (procurement permitting).
- Access to required compliance artifacts (SOC 2 report, data retention controls) during procurement.

Stakeholders we recorded
- Laura Chen — CTO (technical decision-maker)
- Raj Patel — Head of ML (evaluation lead)
- Angela Moore — Procurement (contract/PO)
- DevOps alias (devops@orchardai.com) — infra lead for connectivity/SSO

Proposed immediate next steps (for alignment)
1) I shared an initial Mutual Action Plan (OrchardAI-MAP-v1.xlsx) attached — it pinpoints milestones, owners, and dates.
2) Schedule a technical deep-dive to scope pilot infra: suggested window 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-12.
3) Provide a draft SOW and ballpark commercial estimate for the pilot and 12-month run-rate (attached).
4) DevOps to confirm SAML metadata and network egress requirements.

Can you confirm the stakeholders and target decision window (you mentioned July earlier — does 2026-07-22 for procurement sign-off still look right?), and whether we should include any additional legal/IT reviewers up front?

Attaching: OrchardAI-MAP-v1.xlsx (proposed milestones)

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0123 | dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
https://redwoodinference.com

---
Attachment: OrchardAI-MAP-v1.xlsx (Excel workbook, 1 sheet: milestones, owners, dates)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orchardai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@orchardai.com>, Angela Moore <angela.moore@orchardai.com>, devops@orchardai.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchard AI discovery — recap, success criteria, and proposed MAP

Thanks, Dylan — nice summary and the MAP looks useful. A few quick clarifications and asks from our side:

- Pain points check: correct on latency and cost. One additional constraint: we have a strict 7-day data retention window for logs tied to PII. How logs are retained during the pilot matters for our audit.
- Timeline: our internal calendar moved a bit — Raj wants the pilot fully evaluated by the week of 2026-07-06 so our leadership can make a recommendation to Procurement by 2026-07-12. Procurement (Angela) has a heavy July schedule but said she'd prioritize if we have a clear SOW and SOC 2 artifacts.
- Tech asks: we need SAML SSO + SCIM for user provisioning for the console, and outbound IP ranges for any firewall rules.
- Commercial: can you provide a pilot price range (ballpark $) and an estimate for 12-month committed cost assuming a Dedicated pool? We're sensitive to the first-year effective rate.

Also looping Raj on technical readiness.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orchardai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, devops@orchardai.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchard AI discovery — recap, success criteria, and proposed MAP

Laura — appreciate the quick response and the additional constraints. Quick answers + updated MAP milestones below. I've attached a draft SOW (SOW-draft-OrchardAI-v0.3.docx) with pilot scope and acceptance criteria.

Short answers
- Retention: we can configure log retention and provide a retention policy export for the pilot; default pilot config will respect a 7-day window for any PII logs.
- SSO/Provisioning: we support SAML + SCIM; we'll request SAML metadata from your DevOps team and provide a test tenant.
- Outbound IPs: will share the current egress range in a follow-up; we can also support VPC peering for Private deployments.
- Commercial ballpark: Pilot (4 weeks) estimate: $18k–$25k depending on throughput profile and model variant. 12-month projected committed Dedicated run-rate: ~$120k–$150k (depending on quantization and throughput). We'll formalize these in the SOW and pricing worksheet.

Updated Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Pilot kickoff: 2026-06-15 — Owner: Redwood (Dylan / Solutions Eng) + Orchard (Raj)
- Pilot instrumentation & SSO test: 2026-06-18 — Owner: devops@orchardai.com + Redwood Infra
- Pilot evaluation complete (functional + cost review): 2026-07-06 — Owner: Raj Patel
- Exec review & procurement window: 2026-07-12 to 2026-07-22 — Owner: Laura / Angela
- Contract execution target: 2026-07-22 (PO issuance) — Owner: Angela Moore / Redwood Legal

Actions I will take this week
- Share SOW draft and final MAP (attached).
- Open a HubSpot deal record and post the MAP + artifacts: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/OrchardAI
- Schedule the technical deep-dive with Raj and the Redwood Solutions Engineer (please propose 1–2 windows for next week).

Can you confirm: (a) the 7-day retention requirement is the final constraint we should bake into the pilot; (b) the procurement target 2026-07-22 (we can accelerate if they prioritize)? Once confirmed I'll update the MAP and trigger the SOW/pricing workflow.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0123

- Pilot ballpark $18k–$25k is fine; if they request a committed Dedicated option immediately, we should tee up a 10–15% first-year introductory discount tied to a 12-month commit (subject to finance).
